source: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1meXOw4jR1hh7YXVMeijWwSDIXnCw6Tk4hTZPq2qvyK4 (community relic stacking sheet, "Stackable with self?" column)
notes: stacks: true = copies of the same effect add up. stacks: false = a second copy of the same effect does nothing, but different strengths of it ("+1", "+2") still add up.
effects: corrections to game-data.json, which comes from upstream RelicBrowser.
Character Skill Cooldown, Ultimate Art Auto Charge and Poise +4/+5 came after the sheet (it lists +1/2/3 as stacking); assumed to stack like the rest of their family.
mmv: More Map Variations effects aren't in the sheet. An MMV effect with the same name as a game effect copies its rule; otherwise the first matching pattern wins; otherwise it doesn't stack.
mmv: in possession at start of expedition
